title: Cell-Free Gene Expression (TXTL) Test
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the cell-free gene expression test as outlined by users at TU Munich. See below: *This protocol sets up a cell-free gene expression experiment (TXTL test) in a 384-well plate. A TXTL sample is composed of cell extract (E), buffer (B), and a plasmid coding for the desired genes. The cell extract and buffer volume in each sample is fixed, the volume of plasmid in each sample depends on the plasmid stock concentration and the desired sample concentration of the plasmid. The final volume of 15µl is reached by adding nuclease-free water to the sample.* With the parameters, the user is able to test separate samples for different plasmids coding for the fluorescent proteins (ex. RFP, YFP, GFP and CFP) and measure up to 3 replicates for each of them. In addition, up to two blank samples containing E+B and water are made. First, mastermixes of plasmid and water are made, then distributed to the corresponding wells in the 384-well plate. Then E+B mixes are prepared and also distributed to the corresponding wells. This protocol uses a custom labware definition for the Brand 384-well plate. When downloading the protocol, the labware definition (a JSON file) will be included for use with this protocol. For more information on using custom labware on the OT-2, please see this article: [Using labware in your protocols](https://support.opentrons.com/en/articles/3136506-using-labware-in-your-protocols) In the case that the protocol needs more tips than can be accommodated, the robot will pause, flash the rail lights, and ask the user to replace the tiprack. --- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentrons.com/) or contact our sales team at [info@opentrons.com](mailto:info@opentrons.com) * [Opentrons OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-2) * [Opentrons Thermocycler Module](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid‑water master mixes
steps.instruction: For each plasmid to be tested, calculate the volume of plasmid stock needed to reach the desired final plasmid concentration in a 15 µL reaction, then mix that volume with nuclease‑free water in a tube to create a plasmid‑water master mix (include up to three replicates per plasmid).

substeps.instruction: Calculate required plasmid volume for 15 µL final reaction.
Add calculated plasmid volume to a tube.
Add nuclease‑free water to reach the intended master‑mix volume.

steps.title: Dispense plasmid master mixes
steps.instruction: Transfer the appropriate plasmid‑water master mix to the designated wells of the 384‑well plate according to the experimental layout.

steps.title: Prepare cell‑extract + buffer mix (E+B)
steps.instruction: Combine the fixed volumes of cell‑free extract (E) and buffer (B) in a reservoir to make an E+B master mix that will be added to every reaction well (including blanks).

substeps.instruction: Add the specified volume of cell extract (E) to a tube.
Add the specified volume of buffer (B) to the same tube.
Mix gently to form the E+B master mix.

steps.title: Dispense E+B mix to wells
steps.instruction: Add the E+B master mix to all wells of the 384‑well plate that will receive sample, including the two blank wells that contain only E+B and water.

steps.title: Add water to reach 15 µL total
steps.instruction: Add nuclease‑free water to each well so that the total reaction volume equals 15 µL.

steps.title: Download custom labware definition
steps.instruction: Download the JSON file containing the custom labware definition for the Brand 384‑well plate from the protocol package.

steps.title: Upload labware definition to OT‑2
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons OT‑2 App, upload the downloaded 384‑well plate JSON definition (see Opentrons support article for details).

steps.title: Upload TXTL protocol to OT‑2
steps.instruction: Upload the cell‑free gene expression (TXTL) protocol file into the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the 384‑well plate, tip racks, and any required modules on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate the 384‑well plate, tip racks, and pipette (follow Opentrons calibration guide).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App; if the robot pauses for tip replacement, replace the tip rack as instructed and resume the run.
